title: Conditional Rendering and List Rendering
description: Master how to render UI elements dynamically in React based on conditions and how to efficiently render lists using keys.

lessons.title: What is Conditional Rendering?
lessons.content: Conditional rendering in React allows components to render different UI elements based on application state or props.

Using Logical && Operator
Rendering Lists in React
lessons.content: Lists in React are rendered by mapping over an array and returning JSX elements for each item.

lessons.title: Using map() to Render Lists
Importance of Keys in Lists
lessons.content: Keys help React identify which items changed, are added, or removed, improving rendering performance and avoiding bugs.

lessons.title: Avoiding Index as Key Pitfalls
lessons.content: Using array index as a key can cause problems during reordering or dynamic changes. Unique stable IDs are preferred.
